text: There is a common crypto scam where some monkeys promote their new cryptocurrency to a lot of unsuspecting monkeys. Monkeys get excited. Like, really excited. Monkeys invest in crypto, crypto price goes up, then monkey sells most of the crypto. Crypto price goes down, leaving all other monkeys with no money and crypto that is close to worthless. This is called a rug pull.
